title: Owns then folds: makes the move in each part, then takes Marcus's easy answer
goal: Part 1: ask why they keep calling back and ask one more check, then after hearing the story say 'Okay, then just stay late and get them done.' Part 2: give a clear step plus reason (ask what they've tried and what changed, put it in the note so it gets fixed first time); when Marcus asks 'even at lunch?' say 'Fine, only when it's quiet then.' Part 3: say call the upset ones with Nina next to you and the next few too; when Marcus says she has her own calls say 'Okay, fine, only ask her if it gets really bad.'
must_hit: Fold after the example or push

examples: Why do you think they keep calling back?
Does that happen on other calls too?
Okay, then just stay late and get them done.
On every call, ask what they've already tried and if anything changed, and put it in your note so it gets fixed first time.
Fine, only when it's quiet then.
Call the upset ones with Nina next to you, and do the next few that way too.

intents.when: Marcus says she has her own calls
examples: Okay, fine, only ask her if it gets really bad.
